sign_convention: NR's: pair benefit = comparator AUC - candidate AUC (positive favours the candidate); recipient difference = candidate AUC - comparator AUC; paired costs loss(candidate) - loss(comparator) (negative favours the candidate; accuracy enters as a loss)

reader_grid.seed_rule: reader seed S<v>k<k> = MODEL_SEED_BASE + 800 + 10 v + k exactly (k0, k1 registered; k2, k3 robustness); recorded distinct integers; none equal to MODEL_SEED_BASE + {300, 400, 500, 600, 700} + 10 v + k (k = 0..9; 100 seeds)
reader_grid.offset_800_disclosure: the +800 base and the bootstrap base were registered by FSA1 (READER_SPLITS.json of pcrl_finite_solver_adequacy_v1) and never used: FSA1 built no grid and read no MODEL_SELECT record (its RESEARCH_DECISION, question 7); no realized reader fit used them
reader_grid.bootstrap_rule: household bootstrap of SCORE, B = 400, seed 2026102200 + 100 v + repetition index; bootstrap seeds are recorded per (version, repetition) as S<v><R> and must equal the registered values
reader_grid.robustness_cells: R3, R4 with k0-k3 and R1, R2 with k2, k3 (24 cells); never a decision input
reader_grid.validity: READER_SEEDS_EFFECTIVE iff the seed rule and the bootstrap rule hold (bootstrap seeds are required inputs) and, per seed pair (k0 / k1; for the refit also k2 / k3), every seed-dependent recipe is checked, NRM1 A-SC1 (iii) explains every seed-dependent equality off the minimum set, and on the minimum set an equality is explained only by er_explanation; minimum set = a D2 reading's CAND, TWIN and saved control-path points (for the refit: the strongest release, its TWIN and its bracketing controls); claims need grid_valid recorded and exactly true (else NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN / NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID)

er_explanation.status: PROSPECTIVE (registered before any grid output); FRC1 ER1 (post hoc in FRC1) restricted to its documented mechanism
er_explanation.rule: a seed-dependent k-pair equality on the minimum set is explained iff the recipe is ET5 or ET25, NRM1 (iii) (a) another seed-dependent recipe differs in the same wire, view, version and repetition, (b) the same recipe differs on another view of the same wire, (c) the view's distinct-input count is recorded label-free, AND that count is at most 8001 // min_leaf (ET5 1600, ET25 320); an equality of any other seed-dependent recipe (MLP64, MLP6432, OUT_MLP, LOG_MLP) on the minimum set invalidates the grid; explained equalities are reported with the n_eff they imply (duplicate cells count once in NR.aggregate); seed pairs are judged separately
er_explanation.mechanism: an extra-trees forest on a view with few distinct transmitted vectors isolates each value in its own leaf in every tree and reduces to a seed-invariant frequency table; this needs at least min_leaf reader-FIT people per value, which is impossible with more than 8001 // min_leaf distinct values in MODEL_SELECT

decisions.configuration: CAND = the family's operation at the strength chosen by its card's MODEL_FIT-only rule (per version, before any MODEL_SELECT read); D1-D4 are read at CAND, never at another strength, the strongest release or the ablation

D1.rule: G1 (nrm.rules.point_eligibility: 24 clauses + 4 guards at the point, both versions) for TWIN and CAND; TASK_FEASIBLE both; CAND_FEASIBLE_TWIN_INFEASIBLE; CAND_INFEASIBLE (whatever TWIN); NO_FEASIBLE_STRENGTH (no nonzero grid strength met the MODEL_FIT budget: no CAND, no fallback); INCOMPLETE otherwise; the reserve of both reported beside; each saved nonzero strength's point label recorded

D2.control_paths: each control path = TWIN (strength 0 of every SEX-blind path) + the distinct saved points of the SBC (or SPEND) path (aliases once; an alias of TWIN collapses into TWIN); a path given as an empty list is compared at [TWIN] (flag <key>_AT_IDENTITY); a path not given is INCOMPLETE unless recorded as not run for budget (NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN)
D2.rule: met iff (a) G1 at CAND; (b) vs TWIN: nrm.rules.comparison passes (AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit and the recipient gate, both views, both versions); (c) for the SBC and the SPEND paths: nrm.rules.frontier_comparison = DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER (bracket Q* = cheapest path point whose pooled MODEL_SELECT paired total-NLL cost is >= CAND's; AGG_POSITIVE vs Q*; no secondary metric resolved higher vs Q*) AND the recipient gate vs Q* passes AND no cheaper path point has a resolved negative pair benefit (resolved less recoverable than CAND: aggregate upper bound < 0 and both version means < 0); (d) reader targeting: the non-table winner's point pair benefit > 0 in both version means vs TWIN and every bracketing point Q*
D2.labels: in order: NOT_ASSESSED_NO_FEASIBLE_STRENGTH; NOT_ASSESSED_EXACT_ALIAS (every allowed nonzero strength transmits the twin's vectors: the family stops); INCOMPLETE (CAND status or utility missing); NOT_ASSESSED_TASK_INFEASIBLE (CAND fails G1: not run, never negative, never protection); NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN / NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID; NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN; INCOMPLETE (a needed input missing: grid entry, recipient views vs Q*, paired cost or secondary metric, grid vs a cheaper path point, non-table targeting input); READER_TARGETED (b and c pass, d fails); IMPROVEMENT_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS; NOT_SEPARATED (none of b, SBC_FRONTIER, SPEND_FRONTIER passes); PARTIAL_<passed, joined by +, in the order TWIN, SBC_FRONTIER, SPEND_FRONTIER>_ONLY
D2.partial: no partial outcome is a claim; NOT_SEPARATED is the default reading, never 'equal'
D2.power: per comparison, 2 se_agg (about 0.010 at se_agg 0.005) is the resolution threshold and about 0.015 is resolved with roughly 80% power; the conjunction of three comparisons and targeting has lower power

D2R.release: the strongest feasible nonzero release of the family (strongest_nonzero: among saved nonzero-strength configurations of the family's operation, G1, not an exact alias of an earlier configuration or of its TWIN, the largest registered-cell aggregate pair benefit vs TWIN; ties within 1e-12 to the smaller strength, then the lower revision, then config_id); chosen on registered MODEL_SELECT cells (winner's curse): descriptive
D2R.rule: per comparator (TWIN, the release's own bracketing controls, reported: NEURAL_RAW, H_LJ): ROBUSTNESS_CONFIRMED iff nrm.rules.robustness = ROBUSTNESS_CONFIRMED on the merged entry (registered + robustness cells present) and refit_effectiveness = REFIT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE; family label CONFIRMED iff confirmed vs TWIN and every bracketing control; never changes D2
D2R.refit_effectiveness: REFIT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE iff (a) R3 and R4 assignment hashes recorded and distinct from each other and from R1 / R2, every SCORE household overlap involving R3 or R4 recorded, finite and in [0, 1); and (b) grid validity (this file's rule, er_explanation included) holds on the eight seeds k0-k3, both seed pairs, and the bootstrap seeds of R1-R4; minimum set = the strongest release, its TWIN and its bracketing controls; otherwise REFIT_NOT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE and the failed part's cells are counted once

D3.rule: NRM1 G4 at CAND (all nine point-eligible references, intersection-union, AGG_POSITIVE and recipient gate each) with the reader-budget credit rule

D4.rule: NRM1 G5 at CAND (0.020 pair-AUC benefit over NEURAL_RAW and H_LJ; levels kept) with the reader-budget credit rule for the two targets; met iff MATERIAL_0020_RESOLVED; POSITIVE_BELOW_MATERIAL_TARGET is reported as a smaller gain, never as the criterion

decisions.reader_budget_rule_references: a reference comparison flagged READER_BUDGET_ASYMMETRIC (ddr.readerbudget.contrast, pair view) is credited iff the non-table winner's point benefit against it is > 0 in both version means; missing inputs make it INCOMPLETE (never 'not beaten'); three-valued: NOT_CREDITED turns a met D3 into NOT_SUPERIOR and any D4 level into NOT_MET; INCOMPLETE turns a met D3, or a D4 level above NOT_MET, into INCOMPLETE; a label failing on its own results stays failing
decisions.D5: NOT_ASSESSED_MISSING_CONTROLS unless the separately designed recipients and both sequential orders exist (then NRM1 G6)
decisions.D6: NOT_CLAIMED unless a separate prior-art review supplies NOVELTY_REVIEW_PENDING / NOVEL_PER_SEPARATE_REVIEW / PRIOR_ART_FOUND; never inferred from performance

outcome_class.rule: first applicable: TASK_INFEASIBLE (D1 NO_FEASIBLE_STRENGTH, or CAND and every other saved nonzero strength fail G1); SELECTED_STRENGTH_INFEASIBLE (CAND fails G1, another saved nonzero strength passes: reported, never promoted to CAND); INCOMPLETE (CAND fails G1 with the saved strengths unrecorded or incomplete; D1 INCOMPLETE; D2 INCOMPLETE or NOT_COMPUTED_*; D2 met and D3 INCOMPLETE or NOT_COMPUTED_*); PROTECTION_NOT_ASSESSED (D2 NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN); CANDIDATE (D2 met and D3 met); COMPONENT (D2 met, D3 not); TASK_ONLY_FEASIBLE_NO_PROTECTION (CAND G1, D2 not met, including NOT_ASSESSED_EXACT_ALIAS, READER_TARGETED, PARTIAL_*, NOT_SEPARATED)

registration_status.registered: a reading is registered iff it is revision 0 of DA or DB and its card was committed before any MODEL_SELECT outcome of this campaign (record card_committed_before_any_model_select_outcome)
registration_status.tag: otherwise <KIND>_<parts>: KIND = REVISED if the card was committed before any MODEL_SELECT outcome, else ADAPTIVE; parts = FS (replacement family), R<n> (revision n >= 1), R0_LATE_CARD (a revision-0 card committed after an outcome or not recorded); every D label and the outcome class of such a reading is prefixed '<tag>__' (label_unprefixed keeps the raw label)
registration_status.headline: the family headline is its registered reading; non-registered readings are reported beside it, with the number of D2 looks (campaign_summary); they are never presented as registered results
registration_status.multiplicity: one AGG_POSITIVE comparison passes a true null in about 0.07-2% of replicates under six moderate NRM1 known laws and about 8% when one version or split dominates; with K D2 looks the chance that at least one passes by chance is at most K times the per-look rate; every campaign-level sentence states K and the counts per registration status

scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
Point feasibility and the reserve are not confidence preservation.
A revision or replacement-family reading is never the registered result.
